workflow.title: Engineering workflow
workflow.workflow-1: Task, context and definition of done set before the agent runs
workflow.workflow-2: Agents used for implementation, refactoring, debugging and tests
workflow.workflow-3: Diff, tests and architecture reviewed before anything moves on
workflow.workflow-4: Repository docs and rules guide the agent

front-end.title: Front-end applications
front-end.front-end-1: React.js and Next.js, with agents in the flow and the diff reviewed
front-end.front-end-2: TypeScript components and types specified, then reviewed
front-end.front-end-3: Design-to-code, CSS and UI docs checked against the layout
front-end.front-end-5: UI and E2E tests scoped first and checked before merge
front-end.front-end-6: Legacy React modernization from the existing code

impact.title: Impact
impact.impact-1: Less time on repetitive implementation, debugging and documentation
impact.impact-2: Faster reading and modernization of legacy front-end code
impact.impact-3: More tests, with cases proposed by the agent and filtered in review
impact.impact-4: Technical decisions, code quality and architecture stay human
